lines.en: Hello, and welcome to Kamaru Business Japanese.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today is lesson 14: 25 words — surveys & data.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: First, let's listen to a conversation in the shop after closing.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Kimura, have you seen this month's sales graph?
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Yes. We reached our target to some extent.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Yes, it was mostly as forecast. Weekend sales in particular went up.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: It's a good result compared with the past three months, too.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: We're currently running a customer satisfaction survey.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Some of the answers look somehow odd. The same answer goes on for dozens of responses.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: That's not normal. Let's check whether they're from individuals.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Yes. Since we've gone to the trouble of a survey, I want the data to be accurate.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Right. Each staff member's effort matters for improving our service, too.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: How about taking products outside the shop to sell?
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Good idea. Let's share our ideas with each other.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: I'll put the things we want to do into a list.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Thanks. Let's decide the date and time of the event at today's meeting.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: OK. I'll change the shop-floor layout to match the event too.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Now let's go through today's words one by one. First: reading the numbers.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: A picture showing how numbers change.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I put the sales into a graph.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Working out in advance what will happen.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'll forecast next month's sales.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Achieving a goal.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The team achieved this year's goal.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Time that has gone by.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Let's compare it with past data.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Now; the present.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We're in a meeting at the moment.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Looking into something carefully.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We surveyed customer satisfaction.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Actually carrying out a plan.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We'll hold an evacuation drill next week.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Exactly right, with no mistakes.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: My senior colleague always gives spot-on advice.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Next: how much.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Not completely, but quite a lot.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I've got used to the job to some extent.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Mostly; on the whole.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The plan is mostly on track.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Especially.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This summer is especially hot.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Something or other; somehow.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Some loud voices are coming from the meeting room.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Not natural; odd.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This Japanese sounds a little unnatural.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Ordinary, nothing special.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I usually get to the office at nine.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Said of effort that was made on purpose, often wasted.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The materials I worked so hard on were deleted.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: This day.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today I have a meeting from the afternoon.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Last: working together.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Each individual person.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This is my personal opinion.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Working hard towards a goal.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Daily effort led to results.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Getting better; improving.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: My Japanese improved through the training.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Each other.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Let's help each other.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Putting things together or matching them up.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We'll fit the time to the customer's schedule.
lines.name: 中村

segments.meaning: to take out; to bring up (a topic)

lines.en: Taking something outside; also bringing up a topic.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Please don't take company documents outside.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Names or items written out in a row.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I made a list of participants.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: The date and time.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'll email the meeting's date and time.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Deciding something firmly.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The new store's location has been decided.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Finally, let's check with a quiz. Choose the answer from 1 to 4.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 1. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 3: 達成, achieved.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 2. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 1: おおむね, mostly.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 3. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 2: 不自然, unnatural.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: The materials I ___ worked on were deleted.

lines.en: Question 4. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 4: せっかく, that I took such trouble over.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 5. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 2: 日時, date and time.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.name: ナレーター
